behavior_contract: 1. Gap-first entry copy: pristine state renders the set card with eyebrow 'Guided lessons for this note', heading "Which concept don't you understand yet?" and subline "We'll explain it simply and check your understanding. Pick any lesson — any order works." (SME diagnostic framing of record; any-order affordance made explicit). The neutral catalog heading returns once engaged.

2. Selection-first collapse: on any concept pick (any order — including a first pick of lesson 1, which leaves no progress footprint) the card collapses to a slim header row: name + 'Lesson N of M — <active title>' + live 'X of Y complete' + hairline progress; the full list stays one click away (aria-expanded toggle, 'Show/Hide the lesson list'), reproducing SME's '<- Back to concepts' hop without giving up the persistent progress anchor. Picking a concept from the expanded list re-collapses the card.

3. moduleDone honesty companion fix: 'complete' now means the module was actually walked (gate rated AND all its checks answered) instead of 'positioned before the active module' (mi < moduleIndex). Sequential walkers get identical numbers; any-order walkers no longer see skipped modules counted complete / labelled Review. Disclosed as in-scope because R-7c's any-order framing makes the old counter self-contradictory at the new slim header (observed live: '2 of 3 complete' after an untouched any-order entry).
implementation.state_model: engaged = picked(UI) || moduleIndex!==0 || stage!==0 || ratings/answers/recalibrated non-empty; listExpanded = listOpen ?? !engaged; reset() clears picked+listOpen+store. SSR/prerender still renders the pristine entry card (server snapshot) and re-renders to restored browser-local state after mount — the documented useSyncExternalStore pattern of this file. No schema, corpus, API or DB changes; browser-local persistence law unchanged (zero-DB).
